Named tests cover TEST-MCP-SESSIONATTR-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: Unit tests prove filesModified or commit paths outside the workspace root are rejected or stored only with a foreign marker. Validates TR-MCP-SESSIONATTR-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-108.

acTexts: Named tests cover TEST-MCP-FAILSAFE-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: Pester proves Test-ReplFailsafeBackendUnreachable is true for backend_unavailable and HTTP 503, drain does not increment drainAttempts or quarantine on that abort, and a later drain in the same process can replay. Validates TR-MCP-FAILSAFE-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-159.

acTexts: Named tests cover TEST-MCP-STRICTCOUNT-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: Pester proves workflow.sessionlog.updateTurn succeeds for omitted, empty, and single scalar tags/contextList under StrictMode with exit 0. Validates TR-MCP-STRICTCOUNT-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-158.

acTexts: Named tests cover TEST-MCP-XAGENT-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: Pester proves CompleteTurn refuses a GrokCode/ClaudeCode sessionId on a Codex current-turn and still completes a same-agent sessionId rotation without Submit 500. Validates TR-MCP-XAGENT-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-106 / BUG-TRIAGE-142.

acTexts: Named tests cover TEST-MCP-SESSIONEND-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: Pester proves SessionEnd with no MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH exits 0 and writes {}. Identifiable workspace still flushes. Validates TR-MCP-SESSIONEND-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-140.

acTexts: Named tests cover TEST-MCP-VERIFYWRAP-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: Pester proves code-verify maps disk-full IOException to a typed status and returns within the documented timeout after a childless hang path. Validates TR-MCP-VERIFYWRAP-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-125 / BUG-TRIAGE-130.

acTexts: Named tests cover TEST-MCP-TRANSCRIPT-SEARCH-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: CodexTranscriptAdapterCoverageTests ingest inline JSONL for inter_agent_communication_metadata, tool_search_call, and tool_search_output with zero unknown diagnostics and persist cleanup. Validates TR-MCP-TRANSCRIPT-SEARCH-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-122.

acTexts: Named tests cover TEST-MCP-TEMPVOL-001 acceptance criteria
test.condition: Pester proves the TEMP alignment helper sets TEMP and TMP to the workspace volume when they differ, and does not call PSGallery internals. Validates TR-MCP-TEMPVOL-001 / BUG-TRIAGE-117.
